description: Search US federal trademarks by mark text — the clearance/knockout-search path. Find registered and pending marks by wordmark without knowing a serial or registration number, then filter by international class and live/dead status to see which marks are actually enforceable. Also finds every mark held by a company: pass owner (e.g. "Nike") to list the trademark portfolio of a brand owner. Covers the full USPTO register (the Trademark Search system that replaced TESS). Keyless. Use this to check whether a proposed brand name conflicts with existing US trademarks. Returns wordmark, serial and registration numbers, status, live flag, international classes, goods/services, owners of record with role and entity type, attorney of record, filing dates, and data_as_of (when USPTO last loaded each record). For a name-availability check, set live_only:true and pass the relevant class (e.g. 35 for advertising/business, 42 for software/SaaS, 9 for downloadable software).

international_class.description: Optional Nice class filter. Accepts "35", 35, "IC 035", or "035". Common: 9 (software), 35 (advertising/business/retail), 42 (SaaS/tech services).

live_only.description: If true, return only live marks (registered or pending) — the set that can actually block a new application. Default false (includes dead/abandoned/cancelled).

owner.description: Owner-name filter (e.g. "Nike", "Mondelez"). Pass owner alone (no query) to list that owner's whole portfolio.

query.description: Mark text to screen (e.g. "TenderBrief"). Matches the wordmark field. Required unless owner is given. Advanced: pass fielded Lucene (e.g. 'wordmark:apple AND ownerName:"Apple Inc"') and it is used verbatim.

name: search_trademarks

outputSchema.description: USPTO trademark search. A zero-hit search returns the same shape with results:[] and count:0.

cleared.description: Present only when total_matches is 0. Always null: a knockout search cannot establish that a mark is available, so we never assert it is clear.

data_as_of.description: Newest USPTO load timestamp among the returned records

note.description: Present only when total_matches is 0. States what the query did NOT search, so absence in this index is not read as absence of blocking rights.

data_as_of.description: When USPTO last loaded this record into the register index

location.description: City / state / country for organisations only; always null for natural persons. Street addresses are never served.

total_is_capped.description: True when total_matches hit the upstream cap and is a floor, not an exact count

title: Search Trademarks
